## Pull request overview

This PR fixes a React error (#31) that occurred when CRM dashboard widgets passed I18nLabel objects (e.g., `{key: 'crm.dashboard.trendLabel', defaultValue: 'vs last month'}`) as props to MetricWidget and MetricCard components, which attempted to render these objects directly as React children.

**Changes:**
- Added `resolveLabel()` helper function to convert I18nLabel objects to strings before rendering in MetricWidget and MetricCard
- Widened prop types to accept both string and I18nLabel union types for label-related properties
- Added 3 new test cases to verify I18nLabel resolution works correctly

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 5 out of 5 changed files in this pull request and generated 5 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/plugin-dashboard/src/MetricWidget.tsx | Added resolveLabel() helper and updated prop types; applied resolution to label, description, and trend.label |
| packages/plugin-dashboard/src/MetricCard.tsx | Added resolveLabel() helper and updated prop types; applied resolution to title and description |
| packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/MetricCard.test.tsx | Added 2 test cases for I18nLabel resolution in title and description |
| packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DashboardRenderer.widgetData.test.tsx | Added integration test for metric widgets with I18nLabel trend labels |
| ROADMAP.md | Documented the bug fix with root cause, solution, and test coverage |
</details>

The resolveLabel function duplicates logic that already exists in @object-ui/react's resolveI18nLabel utility (packages/react/src/utils/i18n.ts). However, resolveI18nLabel is not currently exported from the `@object-ui/react` package index.

Consider either:
1. Exporting resolveI18nLabel from `@object-ui/react` and importing it here to reduce duplication
2. Creating a shared utility package for common label resolution logic

This same pattern appears in DashboardRenderer.tsx (line 17), MetricCard.tsx (line 16), and packages/layout also has its own resolveLabel implementation.

The type signature for I18nLabel objects uses optional key (`key?: string`), but the canonical I18nLabel type from `@objectstack/spec` (as seen in packages/types/src/app.ts:59) defines key as required (`key: string`). This creates a type mismatch where the component accepts invalid I18nLabel objects without a key property.

Consider aligning with the spec by making key required: `{ key: string; defaultValue?: string }`. The fallback logic (line 11) should still handle the case where key is present but defaultValue is not.

The prop types have been widened to accept I18nLabel objects, but there's no direct unit test for MetricWidget component with I18nLabel props. While the integration test in DashboardRenderer.widgetData.test.tsx (lines 227-264) covers this scenario through the dashboard renderer, consider adding a dedicated MetricWidget.test.tsx file with direct component tests similar to MetricCard.test.tsx. This would provide better isolation and make the component more maintainable.
